scope: Read-only generation-2 no-ResizeObserver correction review against preserved generation-1 source. No source edits, tests, builds, browser, remote, index, version or publication action by this reviewer.

conclusions.finding: The getter reports the actual owned observer, not API availability. It becomes false during cached-page suspension and after terminal disposal, true again only when restoration creates a replacement, and false on hosts without the API. Existing generation/disposed/suspended fences remain unchanged; no new observer or lifetime owner is introduced.

Both seats finish stats and encounter DOM updates before refreshBoardLayout and before either real BoardPainter.draw. On hosts without an owned observer, hidden/title/instruction values join the layout key. Thus a real cue transition can refit both seats in the same drawing frame instead of preserving a stale scale until an unrelated menu/viewport transition.

The observer path excludes changing cue text from its signature. Ordinary frames compare state values only and keep consuming cached width; client geometry is read only after a changed layout signature, explicit geometry/lifecycle event, or targeted fallback. The helper still observes parent content boxes and writes only absolutely positioned child dimensions, with the existing numeric duplicate-write guard.

The fifth test uses the real authored sentinel campaign, actual Couch host and BoardPainter, and ordinary zero-input ticks to reach warning at tick 241. Its finite independent arena-height getters depend on actual cue phase. There is no ResizeObserver, resize event, fit stub or direct run mutation. It requires both cue phases to be warning before either draw and exact seat widths 300/312, retaining the same run and backdrop references.

Three unchanged zero-time frames must produce no further geometry reads and preserve the checkpoint. The opt-in rendering harness is byte-identical to generation 1, so the existing default-stub behavior for other host consumers is unchanged.

The new prose describes conditional fallback reconciliation after both cues update and before either draw. The narrow-board limitation is now accurately identified as a 72-column board, retaining the 13.33 CSS pixel cap and native-readability evidence boundary.

evidenceLimits: Generation-1 source/test review and its reported 352/352 runtime cohorts remain predecessor evidence. They are not relabelled as qualification of these changed generation-2 bodies.
The host peer separately reported 5/5 Node 20 and Node 22 plus a focused fallback pass. This review inspects source and pins; it does not rerun or certify those receipts or the parent full cohort.

Finite arena dimensions, Image objects and Canvas2D operation traces do not prove native CSS layout, actual raster readability, production asset decoding, physical input or measured frame-time performance.

No claim of full P08-A/P08-B completion, native/public/offline acceptance, version commitment or deployment is made. The existing 64-logical-pixel cap remains unresolved for sufficiently narrow boards.
